1.text: Bwenge yubatse inzu ye,Yabaje inkingi zayo ndwi,

2.text: Abaga amatungo ye,Akangaza vino ye,Aringaniza n'ameza ye.

3.text: Maze atuma abaja be,Arangurura ijwi ari aharengeye hose ho mu murwa,

4.text: Ati “Umuswa wese nagaruke hano.”Abwira utagira umutima ati

5.text: “Ngwino urye ku mutsima wanjye,Kandi unywe kuri vino nakangaje.

6.text: Mureke ubupfapfa mubeho, mwa baswa mwe,Kandi mugendere mu nzira y'ubuhanga.

7.text: “Ucyaha umukobanyi aba yikoza isoni,Kandi uhana umunyabyaha aba yihamagariye ibitutsi.

8.text: Ntuhane umukobanyi kugira ngo atakwanga,Ariko nuhana umunyabwenge azagukunda.

9.text: Bwiriza umunyabwenge kandi azarushaho kugira ubwenge,Igisha umukiranutsi kandi azunguka kumenya.

10.text: “Kūbaha Uwiteka ni ishingiro ry'ubwenge,Kandi kumenya Uwera ni ubuhanga.

11.text: Ni jye uzakugwiriza iminsi,Nkakungura imyaka yo kubaho kwawe.

12.text: Niba uri umunyabwenge,Ubwo bwenge ni wowe ubwigiriye ku bwawe,Kandi nukobana ni wowe biziberaho ubwawe.”

13.text: Umugore upfapfana arasakuza,Ni ikirimarima kandi nta cyo amenya,

14.text: Yicara mu muryango w'inzu ye,Ari ku ntebe aharengeye ho mu murwa,

15.text: Agira ngo ahamagare abahita,Baromboreje mu nzira zabo ati

16.text: “Umuswa wese agaruke hano.”Abwira utagira umutima ati

17.text: “Amazi yibwe araryoshye,Kandi umutsima urirwa ahihishe uranyura.”

18.text: Ariko ntazi ko abapfuye ari ho bari,Kandi abo yararitse bari mu mworero w'ikuzimu.
